comment: Spell binding and an expert through his personal experiences in the mideast. He knows Prime Ministers and visited extensively in the ME. He also was involved with the Arab community in Richmond.

um this man is insane. he is so quirky-beyond a good level, has obvious favorites and little to no structure. his lectures are so outthere and often irrelvant and is not to say the least "politically correct".
He is hysterical.  Throughly enjoyed his lectures.  Ask him about divorcing his wife because she couldn't cook toast.

hahahahahah.....WOW!!  BOGLE my man, U R THE MANN!!  Awesome teacher.  Is he hard? you are probably pondering,(as we all do, dont we).  Well let me break it down for u.  If u are looking for a Core class that really challenges you, makes you write a lot, and makes you think, this is NOT the class for u.  If u want easy, funny old guy, then sign up!

THIS GUY IS CRAZY! if you have a choice of what core class you want to take, take this one.  We've had 2 essays all year and reading the books almost seems optional.  you may even get to see him do his cat or snake impersonation or hear stories about the middle east and his drinking with russians.

Great teacher, a little spacey sometimes. Very informal class. Doesn't go by a syllabus, assigns whatever he feels like/thinks is fair. Have only had 2 papers all year and its April. No tests. Most people hated Core, my class actually looked forward to going. Doesn't give anything lower than a B-
Outstanding teacher.  His enthusiam is addictive in classroom lectures.  His tests are not too challenging if you go to class and read the textbook.  Check out his wicked cool beard.
He is awesome!  Such a fun class and you learn so much.  His final was pretty difficult, but he grades fairly easily.

THIS guy is crazy! but that's what makes the class so awesome.  just to give you an idea, our final was a skit where you had to play two different characters.  He rocks and he's not afraid to speak his mind.
Emory Bogle is the best core teacher ever.  His class might be the only one where teh kids actually enjoy going to core
